episodes.title: The Borrowed Credential
episodes.setup: Amara's name appears in the access log.
episodes.reveal: Her credential was issued before she moved in.
episodes.hook: Who retained the original household account?

episodes.title: The Second Account
episodes.setup: David compares conflicting access records.
episodes.reveal: An estate service account remained active.
episodes.hook: Why did the estate still control access?

episodes.title: Rain Inside
episodes.setup: Morris examines water behind the bolted door.
episodes.reveal: The water came from an internal service stair.
episodes.hook: Why is the stair missing from the public plan?

episodes.title: A House Remembered
episodes.setup: Amara searches Adrian's ordinary household papers.
episodes.reveal: A maintenance invoice names a former attendant.
episodes.hook: The attendant has been ordered not to speak.

episodes.title: Before the Marriage
episodes.setup: The attendant asks why the family distrusts Amara.
episodes.reveal: Amara reveals Adrian's proposal and his family's refusal.
episodes.hook: Someone is recording the attendant's visitors.

episodes.title: The Unsent Warning
episodes.setup: David finds an intercepted warning to Amara.
episodes.reveal: An employee reported reused access before the kidnapping.
episodes.hook: Who stopped the message reaching her?

episodes.title: The Wrong Footprints
episodes.setup: An innocent worker is blamed for a trace.
episodes.reveal: Morris establishes that evidence was planted.
episodes.hook: Its source links to an estate contractor.

episodes.title: The Door Below
episodes.setup: The contractor's plan is recovered.
episodes.reveal: Victor could leave while the ordinary doors stayed locked.
episodes.hook: Someone had to release the internal service gate.

episodes.title: Someone Held It
episodes.setup: A witness describes a woman beside the exit.
episodes.reveal: Amara's sighting is corroborated: Victor had help.
episodes.hook: The woman wore an estate staff pin.

episodes.title: The First Promise Kept
episodes.setup: The team closes the compromised access.
episodes.reveal: The house is secured and the innocent worker cleared.
episodes.hook: The staff pin belongs to Adrian's household.

episodes.title: A Seat at the Table
episodes.setup: Amara seeks the household staff list.
episodes.reveal: Orena receives her but refuses to discuss Ethan's status.
episodes.hook: A clerk quietly offers another appointment.

episodes.title: The Clerk's Copy
episodes.setup: Nessa supplies a withheld payment record.
episodes.reveal: The contractor was paid after Adrian died.
episodes.hook: Who authorised the payment?

episodes.title: The Price of Shoes
episodes.setup: Victor claims Amara owes him her prosperity.
episodes.reveal: Amara recalls his aura boasts while she paid their rent.
episodes.hook: An old acquaintance saw him at the estate office.

episodes.title: Not a Stranger
episodes.setup: The acquaintance describes the meeting.
episodes.reveal: Victor met an estate intermediary before Adrian died.
episodes.hook: Can the meeting's date be established?

episodes.title: The Other Side of the Picture
episodes.clue: the other side of the picture
episodes.setup: The complete photograph is recovered.
episodes.reveal: Victor met Kellan, the estate administrator.
episodes.hook: The photographer was paid through the household account.

episodes.title: The Proposal
episodes.setup: Amara explains why she left Victor.
episodes.reveal: He suggested exploiting Adrian; she refused and left him.
episodes.hook: Victor calls the introduction proof the fortune is his.

episodes.title: For His Son
episodes.setup: The bequest is distinguished from the throne dispute.
episodes.reveal: Adrian acknowledged Ethan and made him a private provision.
episodes.hook: The family's copy lacks a supporting page.

episodes.title: The Missing Page
episodes.setup: Nessa finds a filing receipt.
episodes.reveal: The omission predates the kidnapping.
episodes.hook: Where is the original page held?

episodes.title: A Request in Her Voice
episodes.setup: Amara personally challenges the withholding.
episodes.reveal: Her objection enters the record and cannot be described as consent.
episodes.hook: Kellan suspends Nessa's access.

episodes.title: Money Is Not a Father
episodes.setup: The authenticated record is preserved.
episodes.reveal: Victor's alleged debt is exposed as an unsupported demand.
episodes.hook: A payment refers to a private transfer of care.

episodes.title: Green Pin
episodes.setup: The pin identifies Lami, a former attendant.
episodes.reveal: She accepted work described as protecting Adrian's child.
episodes.hook: Lami has not collected her wages.

episodes.title: A Room for One Night
episodes.setup: Lami's booking is secured.
episodes.reveal: She left a note expressing fear of Ethan's collector.
episodes.hook: A witness saw her change vehicles.

episodes.title: The Patient Driver
episodes.setup: A driver asks for protection before speaking.
episodes.reveal: He heard Ethan cry after the house exit.
episodes.hook: Who comforted the baby?

episodes.title: The Cup She Packed
episodes.setup: The driver identifies Ethan's feeding cup.
episodes.reveal: The first independent sighting confirms Ethan alive that morning.
episodes.hook: Lami tried to telephone a clinic.

episodes.title: The Call She Couldn't Finish
episodes.setup: David verifies the call without exposing medical records.
episodes.reveal: Lami asked how to obtain help for a baby in her care.
episodes.hook: Another person interrupted her.

episodes.title: A Brother at the Yard
episodes.setup: Nessa's brother is threatened over her copies.
episodes.reveal: The team reaches him in time and brings him to safety.
episodes.hook: He saw the contractor's receiving desk.

episodes.title: The Receiving Desk
episodes.setup: His account identifies Lami's recruiter.
episodes.reveal: The recruiter used the royal household's name.
episodes.hook: She retained a signed instruction.

episodes.title: What Lami Believed
episodes.setup: Lami contacts Amara through a protected channel.
episodes.reveal: She believed a family custody dispute was being settled.
episodes.hook: Will she identify Victor directly?

episodes.title: A Place to Speak
episodes.setup: The player helps secure Lami's interview.
episodes.reveal: Lami confirms Victor carried Ethan from the service stair.
episodes.hook: Who supplied the instruction?

episodes.title: The First Accomplice
episodes.setup: Lami gives corroborating evidence and remains available.
episodes.reveal: The access conspiracy no longer rests solely on Amara's account.
episodes.hook: Kellan's authorisation appears on the transfer.

episodes.title: The Letter Victor Kept
episodes.setup: Victor sends part of an old love letter.
episodes.reveal: Amara recognises writing from before the separation.
episodes.hook: The missing ending changes its meaning.

episodes.title: The Last Week's Rent
episodes.setup: An old neighbour describes Amara leaving.
episodes.reveal: The separation preceded her acceptance of Adrian.
episodes.hook: Victor threatened to collect his reward later.

episodes.title: A Man Who Returned
episodes.setup: Amara remembers Adrian's visits to her stall.
episodes.reveal: Their relationship grew before his promise of marriage.
episodes.hook: A saved message records his argument with his family.

episodes.title: The Door She Wasn't Offered
episodes.setup: The family rejection is heard in context.
episodes.reveal: Opposition to the marriage began before Ethan's birth.
episodes.hook: Kellan handled Adrian's finances during that dispute.

episodes.title: The Name at Birth
episodes.setup: Adrian's acknowledgement is recovered.
episodes.reveal: He recognised Ethan despite his family's refusal.
episodes.hook: Why was it omitted from a later statement?

episodes.title: After the Funeral
episodes.setup: Victor's attempt to reclaim Amara is reconstructed.
episodes.reveal: She explicitly refused him rather than inviting negotiation.
episodes.hook: His messages changed from affection to payment.

episodes.title: Someone Who Listened
episodes.setup: David recalls repairing Amara's business website.
episodes.reveal: Their relationship began through ordinary trust.
episodes.hook: Who told Victor about them?

episodes.title: A Photograph Sent On
episodes.setup: The source of a relationship photograph is identified.
episodes.reveal: A household observer reported Amara and David to Victor.
episodes.hook: The observer thought they were helping reconciliation.

episodes.title: Do Not Decide for Me
episodes.setup: David wants to refuse Victor's meeting demand.
episodes.reveal: Amara and David agree on a plan together.
episodes.hook: Amara will speak while her allies verify the surroundings.

episodes.title: What He Really Wants
episodes.setup: Amara draws Victor into discussing the morning.
episodes.reveal: His knowledge corroborates the ransom evidence.
episodes.hook: He says the royal household paid for the car.

episodes.title: The First Car
episodes.setup: The payment is compared with Lami's account.
episodes.reveal: Kellan's office funded the first transfer.
episodes.hook: He calls it ordinary household work.

episodes.title: An Ordinary Invoice
episodes.setup: Nessa produces the instruction behind it.
episodes.reveal: The document falsely describes Amara as unable to care for Ethan.
episodes.hook: Its author never met her.

episodes.title: A Witness to a Stranger
episodes.setup: The author explains the source of the claim.
episodes.reveal: The assessment was manufactured from supplied allegations.
episodes.hook: A message promises discretion to the household.

episodes.title: The House Divides
episodes.setup: Orena confronts the transfer made in her name.
episodes.reveal: She approved an inquiry, not Victor's ransom.
episodes.hook: She prevents Kellan destroying the archive.

episodes.title: A Key Surrendered
episodes.setup: Orena releases a controlled record.
episodes.reveal: The team gains a durable source within the household.
episodes.hook: It identifies a private receiving house.

episodes.title: Not the Heir They Wanted
episodes.setup: Kellan's succession concerns are established.
episodes.reveal: His motive is distinct from Victor's financial grievance.
episodes.hook: A relative offers conditional help.

episodes.title: The Condition
episodes.setup: The offer requires Amara's silence.
episodes.reveal: She rejects the bargain without surrendering her evidence.
episodes.hook: A younger employee breaks ranks.

episodes.title: The Rooms Prepared
episodes.setup: The employee describes supplies ordered for Ethan.
episodes.reveal: The transfer included arrangements for infant care.
episodes.hook: One order names a carer outside Victor's circle.

episodes.title: Two Plans, One Child
episodes.setup: The correspondence is reconstructed.
episodes.reveal: Kellan wanted concealed custody; Victor converted it into ransom.
episodes.hook: The men are withholding information from each other.

episodes.title: An Order He Didn't Sign
episodes.setup: A later movement lacks either man's valid authority.
episodes.reveal: Another participant has taken initiative.
episodes.hook: Who now has responsibility for Ethan's care?

episodes.title: The Carer's Number
episodes.setup: The supply order yields a professional contact.
episodes.reveal: The contact is a real carer, not an invented identity.
episodes.hook: She requests a detail only Ethan's mother would know.

episodes.title: The Blue Stitch
episodes.setup: Amara describes a repair in Ethan's cover.
episodes.reveal: The carer correctly identifies the repaired seam.
episodes.hook: A trusted intermediary can arrange contact.

episodes.title: One Sound
episodes.setup: The carer supplies a brief recording.
episodes.reveal: Amara recognises Ethan, but its age is uncertain.
episodes.hook: A separate delivery record may date it.

episodes.title: The Delivery Bell
episodes.setup: A background sound is compared with the record.
episodes.reveal: Recent proof of life is independently supported.
episodes.hook: A new instruction orders movement.

episodes.title: No More Silent Cars
episodes.setup: The team confronts the transport contractor.
episodes.reveal: One available transport route is closed permanently.
episodes.hook: An alternative pickup is expected.

episodes.title: The Car That Never Came
episodes.setup: The pickup does not arrive.
episodes.reveal: The team's intervention prevents that relocation.
episodes.hook: The carer asks protection for another dependant.

episodes.title: A Promise to the Carer
episodes.setup: The player helps protect the threatened dependant.
episodes.reveal: The carer can cooperate without abandoning her family.
episodes.hook: She agrees to identify the current district.

episodes.title: The Wrong Window
episodes.setup: A recent photograph narrows the building type.
episodes.reveal: One candidate is eliminated before a reckless intervention.
episodes.hook: A visible repair identifies another candidate.

episodes.title: A Room with Light
episodes.setup: An independent source checks the candidate.
episodes.reveal: Ethan's location is narrowed to a small group of houses.
episodes.hook: The carer is warned that Victor is approaching.

episodes.title: Victor Outside
episodes.setup: Victor is independently seen at the district.
episodes.reveal: His claim of control can finally be tested.
episodes.hook: The people inside refuse to surrender Ethan to him.

episodes.title: He Has to Ask
episodes.setup: A witness hears Victor demand entry.
episodes.reveal: He no longer has unrestricted access to Ethan.
episodes.hook: Will he admit that to Amara?

episodes.title: A Demand Without a Picture
episodes.setup: Amara requests current proof.
episodes.reveal: Victor cannot verify what he still claims to control.
episodes.hook: He contacts Kellan for leverage.

episodes.title: The Call Between Them
episodes.setup: A preserved message records mutual blame.
episodes.reveal: Their partnership has broken down.
episodes.hook: Kellan claims he can reverse the transfer.

episodes.title: A Signature Withdrawn
episodes.setup: Amara challenges the instruction with authenticated records.
episodes.reveal: The original receiving authority is formally disputed.
episodes.hook: A replacement instruction is being prepared.

episodes.title: The Person Preparing It
episodes.setup: Nessa identifies the document handler.
episodes.reveal: The handler acts under a concealed household mandate.
episodes.hook: Can a witness prove they know about the abduction?

episodes.title: A Warning Received
episodes.setup: The warning's receipt is established.
episodes.reveal: Continued participation cannot be called innocent misunderstanding.
episodes.hook: The handler refuses the replacement instruction.

episodes.title: A Journey Prevented
episodes.setup: The stopped instruction is secured.
episodes.reveal: A planned relocation does not happen.
episodes.hook: The public address is not the actual nursery.

episodes.title: The Safe Address
episodes.setup: The carer explains a protected receiving address.
episodes.reveal: The listed office and the care location are distinct.
episodes.hook: A trusted authority must verify the real place.

episodes.title: Who May Enter
episodes.setup: The team establishes an agreed verification channel.
episodes.reveal: They gain a visit rather than another guessed address.
episodes.hook: Its sponsor is connected to Adrian's last appointment.

episodes.title: A Familiar Name
episodes.setup: The sponsor appears in Adrian's appointment book.
episodes.reveal: The kidnapping and his death share a documented connection.
episodes.hook: Did Adrian record that meeting?

episodes.title: The Appointment
episodes.setup: Amara retrieves Adrian's final diary entry.
episodes.reveal: He planned to dispute a household financial arrangement.
episodes.hook: A witness confirms he kept the appointment.

episodes.title: An Argument Overheard
episodes.setup: The witness describes a dispute about Ethan.
episodes.reveal: Adrian defended his son shortly before his death.
episodes.hook: Someone removed the room recording.

episodes.title: The Copy Nobody Claimed
episodes.setup: A separate recording copy is found.
episodes.reveal: The family was falsely told no copy remained.
episodes.hook: Its timing conflicts with the public account.

episodes.title: Before the Announcement
episodes.setup: The timeline is reconstructed.
episodes.reveal: An estate decision was prepared before the death announcement.
episodes.hook: Preparation alone does not prove murder.

episodes.title: What Suspicion Cannot Do
episodes.setup: Amara confronts the limits of her accusation.
episodes.reveal: Victor's estate visit is proved; his role in the death is not.
episodes.hook: He offers a different participant's name.

episodes.title: The Bargain Refused
episodes.setup: Victor asks to trade information for immunity from blame.
episodes.reveal: His statement is preserved without surrendering the ransom case.
episodes.hook: Can his offered name be independently checked?

episodes.title: Someone Else Was There
episodes.setup: A second source confirms the named participant.
episodes.reveal: Adrian's last evening involved more than Victor and Kellan.
episodes.hook: A departure record appears altered.

episodes.title: The Unchanged Original
episodes.setup: The original departure record is recovered.
episodes.reveal: The alteration happened after Adrian could challenge it.
episodes.hook: Its author is linked to the receiving authority.

episodes.title: His Own Voice
episodes.setup: Amara hears Adrian affirm his provision for Ethan.
episodes.reveal: His commitment is no longer merely reported by others.
episodes.hook: The recording mentions an emergency instruction.

episodes.title: The Letter for His Son
episodes.setup: That instruction is authenticated.
episodes.reveal: It supports action for Ethan without solving the death.
episodes.hook: The receiving authority must answer it.

episodes.title: An Answer Due
episodes.setup: The instruction reaches a named official.
episodes.reveal: Someone is accountable for verifying Ethan's placement.
episodes.hook: The official requests the birth acknowledgement.

episodes.title: His Father's Name
episodes.setup: The acknowledgement and supporting record are produced.
episodes.reveal: Adrian's relationship to Ethan is accepted.
episodes.hook: Kellan's representative raises another objection.

episodes.title: The Mother's Name
episodes.setup: Amara disproves the fabricated assessment.
episodes.reveal: The representative cannot keep reusing the same allegation.
episodes.hook: An intermediary fears public exposure.

episodes.title: The Intermediary's Fear
episodes.setup: The player separates Ethan's safety from the intermediary's liability.
episodes.reveal: A witness discloses the receiving procedure.
episodes.hook: The procedure names only two possible sites.

episodes.title: Two Houses
episodes.setup: Separate checks distinguish the sites.
episodes.reveal: One is administrative; one recently received infant supplies.
episodes.hook: A current confirmation can identify the placement.

episodes.title: Stay Where You Are
episodes.setup: The disputed movement instruction is put on hold.
episodes.reveal: Another relocation is prevented.
episodes.hook: A welfare visitor can now meet the carer.

episodes.title: Someone Sees Him
episodes.setup: The independent welfare visit occurs.
episodes.reveal: Ethan is confirmed alive and receiving care.
episodes.hook: A written obstruction prevents immediate return.

episodes.title: The Obstruction Named
episodes.setup: The obstruction is obtained.
episodes.reveal: It is a contested instruction, not an unexplained disappearance.
episodes.hook: Who has authority to set it aside?

episodes.title: Behind the Signatory
episodes.setup: Nessa traces delegated authority.
episodes.reveal: An office used another person's name to delay action.
episodes.hook: The person whose authority was borrowed agrees to intervene.

episodes.title: A Door No Longer Hidden
episodes.setup: The real authority repudiates the delay.
episodes.reveal: The team gains a specific institutional route toward Ethan.
episodes.hook: Victor discovers how much leverage he has lost.

episodes.title: The Last Ransom
episodes.setup: Victor demands payment again.
episodes.reveal: The team distinguishes his threat from his actual control.
episodes.hook: He threatens a damaging family disclosure.

episodes.title: What He Calls Exposure
episodes.setup: Amara refuses to buy silence about her past.
episodes.reveal: The threat loses its power over her decisions.
episodes.hook: Will the family publicly support the truth?

episodes.title: The Household Statement
episodes.setup: Orena acknowledges Ethan's relationship to Adrian.
episodes.reveal: A public denial used to obstruct the search is withdrawn.
episodes.hook: Kellan challenges the evidence chain.

episodes.title: Every Hand It Passed
episodes.setup: The player reconstructs the transfer chain.
episodes.reveal: There is no unexplained custody gap in the traced segment.
episodes.hook: A final receipt has a disputed time.

episodes.title: The Time We Can Prove
episodes.setup: An independent source establishes the receipt's time.
episodes.reveal: The team identifies the current placement instruction.
episodes.hook: A review can now use the authenticated timeline.

episodes.title: Before the Review
episodes.setup: David prepares the records while Amara prepares to speak.
episodes.reveal: Both distinguish proved facts from unanswered questions.
episodes.hook: The receiving office agrees to live verification.

episodes.title: Not Another Recording
episodes.setup: A trusted visitor verifies the call in person.
episodes.reveal: The next contact cannot be dismissed as a replay.
episodes.hook: The carer asks how Amara settles Ethan.

episodes.title: The Song She Knows
episodes.setup: Amara sings her familiar lullaby.
episodes.reveal: Ethan responds during the independently verified live call.
episodes.hook: The carer agrees to support his return.

episodes.title: A Statement for Tomorrow
episodes.setup: The carer's statement and placement are secured.
episodes.reveal: The next operation has a named place, witness and authority.
episodes.hook: The authority schedules a return assessment.

episodes.title: The Other Side of the Line
episodes.clue: the other side of the line
episodes.setup: The review accepts the factual chain.
episodes.reveal: Ethan is alive at a verified placement; a supervised return assessment is scheduled, not completed.
episodes.hook: Its notice names a representative Amara believed absent from Adrian's last night.
